content.comment_body: Is it possible to use [product_name] to send an email notification based on an input condition? The device will be connected to my home router.
[product_name] is unable to send emails or SMS messages directly. Either function would require extra hardware.

You might want to check information about the [product_name] web server or smartphone apps. Both allow you to read and modify inputs and outputs of [product_name]. Note that your router needs to have a public and static IP address; otherwise, remote access to [product_name] over the Internet will not work.
However, sending emails or SMS through the web server or apps is not possible.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asks whether a [product_name] device can send email notifications when input conditions are met, seeking a remote notification feature. Other users clarify that the device cannot directly send emails or SMS messages, and extra hardware is required for these options. Alternatives like using a web server or smartphone apps are mentioned, but these do not provide the requested automatic email alerts.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects the [product_name] device to independently send email alerts triggered by programmable input conditions without needing any additional hardware.
